app.title: Professor Kalve's Optical Miracle Machine
app.description: Copy text from any image. Text recognition that runs entirely in your browser.

landing.tagline: Copy text from any image. Drop in a screenshot, photo or scan, then select the text right on top of it.
landing.drop: Drop an image here, or click to browse
landing.privacy: Text recognition runs entirely in your browser. Your images are never uploaded.

viewer.areaHint: Drag on the image to mark the area to read
viewer.selectHint: Drag across the image to select text
viewer.readFailed: Text recognition failed. Check your connection and try again.
viewer.noText: No text was found in this image.
viewer.wrongLanguage: If the text is in another language, pick it above.

errors.notLink: That doesn't look like a link to an image.
errors.clipboardEmpty: There is no image or image link on your clipboard.
errors.pasteEmpty: That paste has no image or image link in it.
errors.dropEmpty: That drop didn't contain an image.
errors.notImage: That doesn't look like an image this browser can open.
errors.noSize: That image has no size, so there is nothing to read.
errors.prepare: Could not prepare the image for reading.
errors.noClipboardButton: This browser can't read the clipboard from a button. Press ⌘V / Ctrl+V to paste instead.
errors.clipboardBlocked: Clipboard access was blocked. Press ⌘V / Ctrl+V to paste instead.
errors.pastedData: That pasted image data could not be read.
errors.urlLoad: Could not load that URL. Check your connection and try again.
errors.downloadFailed: That image could not be downloaded (it may be larger than 25 MB).
errors.noProxy: That host doesn't allow direct access, and the image proxy isn't available. Download the image and drop it here instead.
errors.captureUnsupported: This browser can't capture the screen.
errors.captureSystem: Your system settings don't allow this browser to record the screen.
errors.captureStart: Screen capture could not be started.
errors.captureEmpty: The screen capture came back empty.

api.forbidden: This endpoint can only be used by the app itself.
api.invalid_url: That is not a valid public http(s) URL.
api.bad_redirect: The image host redirected somewhere we cannot follow.
api.timeout: The image host took too long to respond.
api.unreachable: Could not reach the image host.
api.upstream_status: The image host responded with HTTP {{status}}.
api.not_image: That URL points to {{type}}, not an image.
api.too_large: That image is too large (25 MB max).
